title: Move marketing behave specs and TS harnesses to Chattic.us-web

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Move to Chattic.us-web: harnesses marketing-ui-harness.tsx,
contact-form-harness.ts, survey-form-harness.ts, analytics-harness.ts from
web/test-support/. Features: beta_pitch, marketing_beta_pitch,
beta_waitlist_marketing_funnel, contact_forms, delegation_ladder_positioning,
waitlist_survey*, page_content_authority, and their step files from
features/steps/. Keep behave as the runner, per the answered question on this
epic.

Do not delete the originals from this repository until the migrated specs pass
green in Chattic.us-web — see this epic's verification section.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Landed in Chattic.us-web@031354c: beta_pitch, beta_waitlist_marketing_funnel, contact_forms, delegation_ladder_positioning, marketing_beta_pitch features plus their step files and the 4 TS harnesses (marketing-ui, contact-form, survey-form, analytics). behave: 5 features, 31 scenarios, 123 steps, all green against the real chatticus package.

Trimmed on the way over: contact_form_steps.py and beta_waitlist_survey_form_steps.py/beta_waitlist_utm_analytics_steps.py dropped their context.api_client/context.plane backend assertions (marketing repo has no control plane). Rate limiting and complete=false signup recording stay covered by this repo's own waitlist_steps.py/waitlist_survey_steps.py, no gap. Two real gaps do open once the OLD scenarios here are deleted (chatticus-cd78ca): contact lead recording (services+training) and waitlist UTM-field persistence have no other coverage in this repo. New backend-only Gherkin for both needs to land in the same change that deletes the old cross-repo scenarios -- flagging here so it isn't missed.
